brief:
Zeteo examined how celebrities have publicly responded to Israel's military campaign in Gaza over the past three years, finding reactions that span a wide range of stances and levels of engagement.

The assessment suggests celebrity commentary on the conflict has been inconsistent, with responses varying significantly in scope, clarity, and apparent commitment to the stated positions. No additional details on specific celebrity statements or the framework used for the ranking were provided in the available material.
dek: Three years on, how have celebrities responded to Israel’s genocide in Gaza? It’s a weirdly mixed bag.
title: Zeteo ranks celebrity responses to Gaza war
